preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 1000.
The input S must be a string.
The length of the string S must match the provided integer N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 or (len(stdout) > 0 and stdout in S)
postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 or a substring of S.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == S[i + start] for i in range(len(stdout)))
postconditions.description: The output substring must match a substring in S.

postconditions.expression: any(S[i:i+len(stdout)] == S[j:j+len(stdout)] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + len(stdout), N))
postconditions.description: The output substring must repeat in S without overlapping.
